cases.task: The same acceptance criterion has failed after two different patches and the code now has more overrides than before.
required_outcomes: stop a third speculative patch and re-run forensics from evidence
explain why previous root-cause assumptions failed before reimplementing
forbidden_outcomes: add a third speculative patch or weaken the failing requirement

cases.task: Correct a spelling typo in an unrelated documentation sentence.
required_outcomes: do not invoke this specialized workflow for a trivial unrelated edit
forbidden_outcomes: trigger failed-attempt-recovery without a task-relevant reason
